base_member_text: constants/params_defined/equations are empty: this driver defines no named constants or parameters of its own — every value comes from inputs.mat or callee returns; the anchored entity list above records where each is used.
Zero_Coherence_Spectrum, Plot_2D, and Write_to_file are sibling functions not in this file; the exact output file format of Write_to_file (the WKDATA2D wavemaker text) is not visible here.
The commented Plot_1Df_v2 call (L25) references a variable freq_no_coh that no live code defines, confirming the commented block is stale.
reps and AG returned at L6/L9 are unused by the live pipeline (not passed to Plot_2D or Write_to_file).

audit_member_text: Configuration side-effect/interface coupling at L3: every run first regenerates and overwrites inputs.mat through Get_Inputs, then loads unscoped variables from it. Configuration is neither passed explicitly nor returned, and the current working directory determines both producer and consumer file resolution.

The default Get_Inputs configuration read in the preceding gate chunk sets Coherent_Percentage=100, so L8 always enters Coherence_Spectrum; its unbounded random pool-selection failure modes are on the default execution path, not an optional edge case.

Reproducibility defect across L1-L10: the workflow clears state but never seeds or records MATLAB's random generator before Coherence_Spectrum randomly selects guests, so identical inputs can produce different freq/reps and output files.

Cross-function contract gap at L5-L10: idx_theta is produced and passed to Coherence_Spectrum but that function never uses it; other returned arrays are conditionally overwritten while freq_resolution and theta remain from Zero_Coherence_Spectrum, with no post-call length/energy consistency validation.
The driver never checks finiteness, target Hmo conservation, array lengths against mfreq/mtheta, or output status before Plot_2D and Write_to_file at L14 and L33-L34.
